title: Single cell isolation from human fetal thigh
author: Hongbo Zhang

steps_raw.instruction: Single cell isolation from human fetal thigh
2. Forceps and scissors
1. Liberase TH stock solution (Sigma 5401135001)
2. 10x Red blood cell lysis buffer; RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4300) or 1X RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4333).
1. Liberase TH stock solution (Sigma 5401135001)

a. This stock solution is prepared by dissolving 1 vile of 5mg Liberase TH powder in 2ml of 1X PBS so that the final concentration is 2.5 mg/ml. The liberase TH stock solution can be store as 400ul aliquots at −20°C. Thaw on ice before use.
b. Liberase working solution: 5ml, dilute Liberase TH stock solution in 1X PBS (100ul enzyme stock + 4.9ml 1x PBS).
2. Red blood cell lysis buffer (RBS)
This solution is prepared by diluting 10X RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4300) 1:10 with room temperature, reagent-grade water.
Alternatively, 1X RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4333) can be used directly.
! Only 1X RBC is used in the protocol!
This solution is prepared by diluting 200ul FBS + 9.8ml 1X PBS.
Experimental procedure:
! Prepare all the buffers before the experiment!
! Perform the experiment on ice!
Dissect the left and right thigh to two pieces of whole upper half of the fetal thigh.
Keep one of the two pieces in 10% neutral-buffered formalin for histology or RNAscope. Take a note of the tissue ID that comes from the hospital for the database.
Place the other piece of tissue in a 60mm dish avoiding the center of the dish and closer to the wall area. Mechanically chop the muscle into a mash with a scalpel.
While holding the dish under the angle:
Add 2ml of Liberase working solution to the tissue mash. Transfer the chopped tissue into the 15ml falcon tube.
Apply another 2ml of Liberase working solution to the area with the tissue and transfer to the 15ml falcon tube.
Apply the last 1ml of the Liberase working solution to the same location and transfer to the same 15ml tube.
It should be in total 5ml of the tissue/buffer solution.
Incubate the 15ml tube with the tissue/buffer for 30min in a 37 degrees water bath. After 15min digestion, gently mix the tissue/buffer solution with 1ml tip to facilitate the digestion.
Visually check the tissue and if it is not fully digested keep the tissue/buffer for another 5min in 37C. NOTE: Do not exceed 40min of incubation time in total.
Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4C at 750g for 5min. Visually check the presence of the cells and tissue debris at the bottom of the tube. Carefully decant the supernatant.
NOTE: (If the fetal is younger than 8 weeks, the steps 8-12 can be removed)
Resuspend the cell in 3ml of 1X RBS buffer. Incubate for 4–5 min at RT.
Stop the lysis reaction by adding 10 mL of 1X PBS. Gently Mix the solution.
Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4C at 750g for 5min. Visually check the presence of the cells and tissue debris at the bottom of the tube. Carefully decant the supernatant.
Troubleshooting: If the pellet is not visible add 300ul of FBS to get the final 2% solution. Mix well and spin down again at 4C at 750g for 5min.
Resuspend the cells in 5ml of 2% FBS in 1x PBS, filter it through a 40um strainer.
Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4C at 750g for 5min. Visually check the presence of the cells at the bottom of the tube. Carefully decant the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 50-200ul of 2% FBS in PBS. The volume of the resuspension buffer depends on the size of the cell pellet.
Mix 10ul of the cells with 10ul of the trypan blue and quantify by counting with a hemocytometer.
